headline.story_zh:
这件东西解决的是所有 AI 推理游戏的通病：**模型能被说服**。你追问几轮、换个角度施压，它就开始改口——凶手是谁取决于你问得多凶，而不是案子本身。

它的做法是把答案从模型手里拿走。开局由脚本生成案件，凶手随机定死，然后**当场算一个 SHA-256 交给你**。作者管这叫 proof-of-honesty，并且要求把哈希原样展示给玩家——**你手上有凭据，模型改不了口，改了你验得出来**。模型在这局里只是舞台：你问谁，它就照那张嫌疑人卡演谁，卡上写着这人的假不在场证明、会回避什么、会撒哪个谎。它连自己在演的是不是凶手都不知道。

真正让我服气的是困难模式。它会塞进一个**指错人的第二证人**——而扮演那个证人的模型，自己也不知道那是假的。所以你没法靠察言观色，只能交叉比对不在场证明。一个把「连我自己都被蒙在鼓里」写进设计的游戏，比任何「我保证不剧透」的承诺都可靠。

它还写了一节「什么时候别用我」：多线战役、开放世界跑团、想写推理小说而不是玩、真实罪案和现实人物——一律礼貌拒绝，也不接非黑色电影的题材。**一个只做一件事、并且把不做的事列出来的小游戏。**

不适合谁：想玩长线战役的人。它就是一局 5 到 15 分钟，打完那个案子文件就结了。
headline.title_zh: 用 SHA-256 锁死凶手的黑色电影审讯游戏
headline.name: noir-interrogation

item.name: noir-interrogation
item.title_zh: 用 SHA-256 锁死凶手的黑色电影审讯游戏
item.tagline_zh: 玩推理最怕 AI 中途被你说服改口。这个把答案的哈希公示在开场简报里，你一间间审嫌疑人，它只照脚本发的卡演。
item.why_zh: 困难模式会塞进一个指错人的假证人，而扮演那个嫌疑人的模型自己也不知道那是假的。
item.limit_zh: 一局 5–15 分钟，单场结束就完，不做多线战役。只有黑色电影一种类型，中途要奇幻或科幻会被拒绝；两套设定是 1940 年代美式与 1930 年代民国上海。作者明写不许 agent 去 Read 或 cat 案件 JSON，一旦绕过脚本，这个设计就作废了。
item.title_en: A noir interrogation game that hashes the killer before you start
item.tagline_en: What ruins AI mysteries is talking the model out of its own answer. Here the solution is SHA-256 committed in the opening briefing, and every suspect is played strictly off a card the script hands over.
item.why_en: Hard mode plants a second witness who names the wrong person, and the model playing that suspect is not told the statement is false either.
item.limit_en: One case runs 5–15 minutes and ends there; no campaigns. Noir only — fantasy or sci-fi requests are declined — in two settings, 1940s America and 1930s Shanghai. The file forbids the agent from ever reading or cat-ing the case JSON, since bypassing the script defeats the whole design.

headline_history.story_zh:
今天这件的招牌是一条自我约束：不调任何图像生成模型。给它一张你自己拍的照片，它用手写 HTML/CSS/SVG 把画面重新画一遍，无头 Chrome 导出 PNG——成品里一个照片像素都没有。

为什么这算品味而不是自找麻烦：所有效果都来自可控的代码，所以出品是稳定的，不是抽卡抽出来的。作者把方法论写得比多数设计文档还狠——「如果观者还在数花瓣，画的就仍是物体」；采样时明令不采轮廓，因为「采了就会忍不住去画」，他还记下了实测：树梢的 141 个锯齿点，让一道横痕被画成了山。

最让我服气的是那条盲画协议。开工先自测三件事，其中一件是「你能看见渲染出来的 PNG 吗」——检验方式是渲染后用一句话说出画面里的三个东西，说不出就是看不见。看不见时强制进入盲画模式：第一版画完立刻交人，此后每一轮改动只能由用户反馈驱动，自发迭代次数为零。一个作者肯把「我的 agent 可能看不见自己画了什么」写进流程并给出降级路径，比任何效果图都更能说明他在乎。

不适合谁：本机跑不了无头 Chrome 和 PIL 的人。缺一样它就降级成交你一个 HTML 文件、颜色请你自己报，手机上基本用不了。

skills.name: sticker-puzzle-memory-card
skills.title_zh: 植被多就换品红键色，把照片做成能剪下来的贴纸页
skills.tagline_zh: 照片做成好看的图不难，难的是拿到一张真能打印、真能剪的透明贴纸。它一次交记忆卡和六枚图案的透明 PNG。
skills.tagline_en: Turning a photo into a pretty image is easy; getting a transparent sheet you can actually print and cut is not. This delivers a memory card and a six-motif transparent PNG together.
skills.desc_en: 将照片转化为水粉剪纸风格旅行记忆卡 + 拼图对比图
skills.why_zh: 去背走色度键，绿场景会撞色，所以植被多的图改用品红打底，最后还要验四角 alpha 是不是 0。
skills.why_en: Background removal runs on a chroma key, and green collides with foliage, so leafy photos are keyed on magenta instead — then all four corner alphas are verified as zero.
skills.limit_zh: 生图模型被写死成 seedream_5.0_pro，接不上这个模型的 agent 装了没用。贴纸恰好六枚、手写关键词恰好三个，都是定死的，不接受你要八枚。原图里的文字只在真的标识了地点时才留，广告、菜单、价格、时间戳一律剔掉。 上游 SKILL.md 的 name 是中文，装上后可能不被识别，改成英文更稳。
skills.limit_en: The image model is hard-wired to one specific generator, so it is dead weight on an agent that cannot reach it. Six stickers and three handwritten keywords are fixed counts; asking for eight is not an option. Text from your photo survives only when it genuinely names a place — ads, menus, prices and timestamps are all stripped. Upstream's name field is Chinese, so the loader may not pick it up — rename it to ASCII.
skills.title_en: Switches the chroma key to magenta when the photo is full of green

skills.name: parametric-3d-printing
skills.title_zh: 动一行几何代码之前先去查真实尺寸的建模台
skills.tagline_zh: 用 CadQuery 分三阶段建模，每阶段渲图给你看、等你反馈再往下，最后出 STL 和打印参数建议。
skills.tagline_en: Builds parametric CadQuery models in three phases, rendering a preview and waiting for your feedback at each one, and finishes with an STL plus print recommendations.
skills.desc_en: Claude Code skill for parametric 3D-printable model generation with CadQuery
skills.why_zh: 接现实产品的尺寸一律去查、交叉两个来源：差一两毫米，这个零件就废了。
skills.why_en: For anything that has to fit a real product it searches for the spec and cross-references two sources, because even 1-2mm off makes the part unusable. And it refuses to disappear and come back with a finished model.
skills.limit_zh: CadQuery 只支持 Python 3.10–3.12，OCC 内核装不上得改走 conda；面向 FDM 功能件，不做渲染、雕刻和游戏资产，也不改你手里已有的 STL。
skills.limit_en: CadQuery needs Python 3.10-3.12; if the OCC kernel won't build you're on conda. Aimed at functional FDM parts — not rendering, sculpting, game assets, or editing an STL you already have.
skills.title_en: It searches for real dimensions before writing a line of geometry

skills.name: cheatsheet-generator
skills.title_zh: 认为页脚留白就是浪费考试资源的速查表
skills.tagline_zh: 读完你的课件和 PDF（图表还会渲成图再看一遍），压成一张多栏彩色 LaTeX 速查表，字号版式你定。
skills.tagline_en: Reads your slides and PDFs — rendering pages to images so it can actually see the diagrams — then compresses everything into one dense, colour-coded multi-column LaTeX sheet.
skills.desc_en: Turn your course slides and PDFs into dense, exam-ready LaTeX cheatsheets.
skills.why_zh: 它的密度规矩：底部留白等于浪费学生的考试资源，能塞就塞满。
skills.why_en: Its density rule is stated outright: a cheatsheet with white space at the bottom is wasting the student's exam resource, so write as much as physically fits.
skills.limit_zh: 输出是 XeLaTeX 源码，要 Overleaf 或本地 LaTeX 才编得出来；抽 PDF 和 PPTX 要 pymupdf 和 python-pptx；配置阶段会起一个本地网页表单；前提是你这门考试允许带速查表。
skills.limit_en: Output is XeLaTeX source; you need Overleaf or a local LaTeX install. Extraction needs pymupdf and python-pptx. Config runs through a local web form. And it assumes your exam actually allows a cheatsheet.
skills.title_en: The cheatsheet that treats white space at the bottom as waste

skills.name: olympiad-problem-generator
skills.title_zh: 几何题严禁文生图、改用代码画课本插图的奥数出题器
skills.tagline_zh: 给年级、章节、难度，出六道例题加十二道作业。图交给脚本画成米色方格纸和 45° 斜线阴影，图里尺寸和题干、答案同源。
skills.tagline_en: Give it a grade, a chapter and a difficulty and you get six worked examples plus twelve homework problems. Figures go to a script that renders beige grid paper and forty-five-degree hatching, and the dimensions in the drawing are the same numbers as the question and the answer.
skills.desc_en: 小学奥数出题器 · OpenClaw Skill：一句话出例题/练习/作业，自带课本风格几何图引擎
skills.why_zh: 答案要用两种方法各算一遍、对上了才写进文档，比如面积同时用大减小和鞋带公式复核。
skills.why_en: Every answer is computed twice by different routes and only written into the document when they agree — an area checked both by subtraction and by the shoelace formula.
skills.limit_zh: 正文把二次把关交给「老师按本班学情」，家长自用也得自己再看一遍。难度只有「举一反三／小蓝本／高斯课本」三个锚点，拿不准它要你先发一页样题对齐，不硬猜。出图靠 matplotlib 与 python-docx，缺库会自己 pip install。它明写不承诺提分。
skills.limit_en: The file hands final review to "the teacher, adjusted for this class", so a parent using it alone still has to check the sheet. Difficulty has only three anchors, and when it cannot place yours it asks for a sample page rather than guessing. Figures depend on matplotlib and python-docx, which it will pip install if missing. It states plainly that it promises no score improvement.
skills.title_en: Geometry figures are drawn by code, never by an image model

skills.name: seedance-2-5-video-director
skills.title_zh: 把想法写成即梦 Seedance 2.5 提示词，绝不替你按生成键
skills.tagline_zh: 即梦每生成一版都在扣积分，改一次就是一次赌。它只交可复制的提示词，遇到「向前续写」这种歧义必须先问你放在原片前还是后。
skills.tagline_en: Every Dreamina render costs credits, so a vague prompt is a paid mistake. It hands you the director's brief and a copy-ready prompt, and never guesses.
skills.desc_en: Design, derive, optimize, diagnose, and rewrite scripts or copy-ready prompts specifically for Dreamina/即梦 Seedance 2.5. Use for new text/image/video/audio-to-video concepts, exact-timeline videos, 30-180-second Long Video, extension, video editing, Clay Renderer, seamless transitions, multi-grid storyboards, realistic acted dialogue, relationship drama, sports or variety-show live camera grammar,
skills.why_zh: 它把边界写成硬规则：只产文字、不调用生成、不花积分；时间戳必须严丝合缝铺满时长，眼泪和脸红不许出现在触发之前。
skills.why_en: The boundaries are hard rules: text only, no job submission, no credits spent. Timestamps must tile the full duration exactly, and a reaction may not land before its cause.
skills.limit_zh: 它不生成视频，只交提示词——粘回即梦、扣积分、返工仍是你的事。绑死 Seedance 2.5 一个模型，正文明写别把这些语法当成其他视频模型的通用规则。默认中文输出；每个新会话第一次调用会先塞一整段强制教学。
skills.limit_en: It writes prompts, not videos — pasting, paying and re-rolling stay with you. Bound to Seedance 2.5, it says not to treat its syntax as universal across video models. Output defaults to Chinese, and each session's first call opens with a tutorial.
skills.title_en: Writes your Seedance 2.5 prompt, then refuses to hit generate

skills.name: design-child-reading-adventures
skills.title_zh: 没核过这一版分页就一个页码都不写的亲子阅读设计
skills.tagline_zh: AI 给孩子设计读书任务最容易翻的车是页码和情节都编的——它把证据分四级，最低那级直接停下来跟你要版权页和目录。
skills.tagline_en: The way AI reading tasks fail a child is invented page numbers and invented plot. This one grades its evidence in four levels and, at the lowest, stops and asks you for the copyright page and the table of contents.
skills.desc_en: 中文儿童阅读冒险设计 Codex Skill：证据核验、阅读依赖玩法与绘本式双文件手册
skills.why_zh: 页码和内容分开把关：内容核实了但这一版的分页没核，就一个页码都不出，只给章节线索。
skills.why_en: Pages and content are gated separately: content verified but edition pagination unverified means no page numbers at all, only a chapter or event cue.
skills.limit_zh: 它要你交出确切的书名、译者、版次、是否删节，还有 ISBN 或版权页——嫌麻烦就只能拿到标着「暂定」的通用框架。正文是英文写的。它明写不做家长打分和持续表现汇报，也不许因为年龄、年级、性别去推断孩子的偏好。
skills.limit_en: It wants the exact title, translator, edition and abridgement status plus an ISBN or copyright page — skip that and all you get is a framework labelled provisional. The file is written in English. It refuses adult grading and continuous performance reports, and forbids inferring a child's preferences from age, grade or gender.
skills.title_en: No page number unless the pagination of that exact edition was inspected

skills.name: create-80s-chinese-art
skills.title_zh: 一出现日漫下巴就整张作废的 80 年代老绘本画法
skills.tagline_zh: 「80 年代中式美学」在它这儿不是风格，是五条谱系：儿童刊物水粉、赛璐珞、民间故事、连环画、抒情山水，一次只准挑一条
skills.tagline_en: "Eighties Chinese aesthetic" is not one style here, it is five separate lineages — children's-magazine gouache, cel animation, decorative folk tale, line lianhuanhua, lyrical landscape — and you may pick exactly one.
skills.desc_en: 80年代中国老绘本艺术方向 Skill：五条视觉谱系（儿童刊物水粉/赛璐珞/民间故事/连环画/抒情山水）参考驱动生成与风格化，含 lineage gate 拒绝混血
skills.why_zh: 泛黄、划痕、颗粒、褪色一律禁止当风格控制——它认为那是老照片的痕迹，不是那个年代的画法。
skills.why_en: Yellowed paper, scratches, grain and fading are banned as style controls. Those are marks left on an old photograph, not how anyone drew back then.
skills.limit_zh: 正向提示词里 cinematic、anime、Ghibli、highly detailed 一律禁用，习惯堆这些词的人会不适应。正文是英文。它明说现代成年人生活场景是很差的首测题，会强激活当下的日漫先验。assets 里 15 张参考图是那年代出版物翻拍，只作风格参考。
skills.limit_en: Words like cinematic, anime, Ghibli, highly detailed and beautiful young woman are banned from positive prompts, which will feel wrong if you are used to stacking them. The file is in English. It warns that a contemporary adult lifestyle scene is a poor first test because it strongly activates current anime priors. The fifteen bundled reference images are photographs of period publications, used for style only.
skills.title_en: One anime jawline and the whole image is rejected

skills.name: plush-doll-designer
skills.title_zh: 给玩偶眼睛定 90 牛拉力的毛绒版型设计台
skills.tagline_zh: 想缝一只自己设计的玩偶，卡在版型怎么拆。它按部件出版型图，标好缝份、毛向和对位点，还告诉你先缝哪一块。
skills.tagline_en: You want to sew a doll of your own design and you are stuck on breaking it into pattern pieces. This issues a pattern per part with seam allowance, pile direction and notch marks, and tells you what to stitch first.
skills.desc_en: TRAE 角色立体化设计三件套：毛绒玩偶、手办GK、拼装模型设计技能
skills.why_zh: 安全线是可量的：眼睛拉力 90N、接缝 70N、左右眼到鼻中线偏差不超 1mm，都写成收针前的自检项。
skills.why_en: Safety here is measurable: 90 N on the eyes, 70 N on the seams, under 1 mm asymmetry from each eye to the nose centreline, all written as checks before you close it up.
skills.limit_zh: 给 0–3 岁做的只能绣眼绣鼻、不许上铁丝，还要求过 GB 6675 全项——家里做不到就别当婴儿玩具送人。它给的是版型图和工序，不出 1:1 可直接打印的纸样，尺寸要你照标注自己放大。同仓另外两件是手办和拼装模型，不随这件走。
skills.limit_en: For ages 0 to 3 it allows only embroidered eyes and nose, bans wire, and demands the full Chinese toy safety standard — if your kitchen table cannot meet that, do not give it to a baby. What you get is pattern drawings and a work order, not a printable 1:1 paper pattern; you scale from the marked dimensions yourself. The two sibling skills in the repo cover figures and model kits and do not come along.
skills.title_en: Specs the eye pull test at 90 newtons before you sew

skills.name: ascii-art
skills.title_zh: 先抢救剪贴板再问你要什么风格的 ASCII 台
skills.tagline_zh: 文字、图片、视频都能转，九种风格四种抖动，可以导成 PNG、SVG、GIF 或带鼠标斥力的交互网页。
skills.tagline_en: Turns text, images or video into ASCII with nine styles, four dithering algorithms, and exports to PNG, SVG, GIF, or an interactive page where the characters push away from your cursor.
skills.desc_en: An agent skill that converts text, images, and video to ASCII art.
skills.why_zh: 你粘一张图，它第一件事是从系统剪贴板抢存成文件：粘完那张图随时就没了。
skills.why_en: When you paste an image, step one is saving it out of the system clipboard immediately — because a pasted image is gone the moment you do anything else.
skills.limit_zh: 首次要跑一遍 setup.sh 建虚拟环境；视频要 ffmpeg 和 opencv；交互式和 React 导出只支持图片视频，纯文字不行；它明确不在终端里预览图像类结果。
skills.limit_en: Run setup.sh once for the venv. Video needs ffmpeg and opencv. Interactive and TSX exports require image or video input, not text. It deliberately won't preview image results in the terminal.
skills.title_en: It grabs the clipboard before it asks you anything

skills.name: bullshit-detector
skills.title_zh: 打叉之前必须先替对方辩护一轮的查证器
skills.tagline_zh: 把视频、文章、推文或 PDF 拆成一条条主张，逐条联网核对，出一张带逐条判定和 0–10 分的报告卡。
skills.tagline_en: Extracts the discrete claims from a video, article, tweet or PDF, verifies each against independent sources, and produces a report card with per-claim verdicts and an overall BS score.
skills.desc_en: Agent skills that fact-check the internet: claim-by-claim verification with sources and a 0-10 BS score for any YouTube video, article, tweet, or PDF
skills.why_zh: 快速模式只砍广度、绝不砍深度：仓促下的冤枉，仍然是冤枉。
skills.why_en: Quick mode cuts breadth, never depth — because a fast false accusation is still a false accusation, and the steelman before any ❌ survives even the fastest run.
skills.limit_zh: 全量模式很慢很费 token，作者自己测过 35 次跑，第一次调工具前的纯思考能占掉 15%；必须能联网搜索，断网时结论不可用；报告是英文体例；它给证据链和分数，不是权威裁定。
skills.limit_en: Full mode is slow and token-heavy; the author instrumented 35 runs and found 15% of all thinking happens before the first tool call. Needs live web search — offline verdicts are unusable. Reports are in English. It gives an evidence trail and a score, not a ruling.
skills.title_en: It has to steelman a claim before it's allowed to reject it

skills.name: breathing-montage
skills.title_zh: 把高密度剪辑排成骨架，白闪只准一帧、全片四次
skills.tagline_zh: 快剪到最后只剩噪音，因为全片一个节奏。它把镜头压成两极——插帧不超过 12 帧、呼吸不少于 2 秒，切点贴 VO 里的名词而不是 BPM 网格。
skills.tagline_en: Fast cutting turns to noise when every shot runs at one speed. Inserts stay under 12 frames, breaths over two seconds, and cuts land on voiceover nouns rather than the BPM grid.
skills.desc_en: Style-agnostic grammar for high-density editing with breathing room ("呼吸式高密度剪辑") — a frame-level rhythm skeleton for 15–120s short films, plus the AI-production discipline to execute it with image/video generation models. Use whenever the user wants: high-density or fast-cut editing that still breathes; a strobe/flash climax sequence; subliminal insert design (2–6 frame cuts); a two-worlds opposit
skills.why_zh: 密度来自双峰分布而不是提速：插帧的帧数绝对、不随片长缩放；正片零溶解，唯一一次溶解留给彩蛋当反语法标记。
skills.why_en: Density comes from a two-peak distribution, not from speed. Insert lengths are absolute frame counts that never scale with runtime, and the only dissolve allowed is the after-credits gag.
skills.limit_zh: 它不碰视频：产出是骨架表和提示词包，落刀要你自己在时间线上数帧。正文明写「只提供语法，不携带任何视觉风格」，色板、题材、年代都得项目自带。六份 references 全中文，戏剧学检查层改写自 smixs/visual-skills 与 DirectorSKILL。
skills.limit_en: It never touches video: you get a rhythm skeleton and a prompt package, and you still count frames on your own timeline. It carries no visual style at all — palette, era and subject come from your project — and every reference file is in Chinese.
skills.title_en: A cut skeleton where the white flash is always exactly one frame

skills.name: boardgame-creator
skills.title_zh: 真人试玩之前不许说「有趣」的实体桌游设计台
skills.tagline_zh: 点子有了，卡在「到底好不好玩」。它先把 6–10 个关键决策一次交底，再逼出一份今天就能手写出来的纸面原型。
skills.tagline_en: You have the idea and you are stuck on whether it actually plays. This states the six to ten decisions that matter up front, then drives you to a paper prototype you could hand-write today.
skills.desc_en: 中文实体桌游创作 Skill：从灵感、纸面原型到试玩迭代与朋友介绍材料
skills.why_zh: 它给自己上了禁令：没经过真人试玩，只能说「可试玩」，不能说「平衡」——纸面审查只找风险，不发合格证。
skills.why_en: It bans itself from certain words: with no real playtest it may only say "playable", never "balanced" — paper review finds risks, it does not issue a pass.
skills.limit_zh: 平衡只能靠真人试玩验，所以你得自己凑齐人——它明写纸面审查不能证明平衡。交付物是纸面原型，美术、量产、众筹一概不管，第一版明说不追求出版。多视角批评里连「易感到被针对者」都算上了，但那仍是模拟，不是玩家。不做电子游戏实现。
skills.limit_en: Balance can only be proven at a real table, so you have to find the players yourself; the file says outright that paper review cannot prove balance. What you get is a paper prototype — art, manufacturing and crowdfunding are all out, and the first version deliberately does not aim at publication. Its multi-perspective critique even includes the player who feels picked on, but that is still simulation, not a playtester. No digital implementation.
skills.title_en: Forbidden to call your game "fun" before humans have played it

skills.name: cook-with-what-you-have
skills.title_zh: 凑不满三道菜也不放宽过敏原的「有啥吃啥」
skills.tagline_zh: 报一下冰箱里剩什么，它挑三道可解释的候选，原菜谱一字不改地端出来，缺什么料另写在原文之外。
skills.tagline_en: Tell it what is left in the fridge and it picks three explainable candidates from HowToCook, serving the original recipe text unchanged with the match notes and shopping gaps kept outside it.
skills.desc_en: 根据现有食材、饮食约束和厨具，从 HowToCook 推荐可解释菜谱的本地优先 Agent Skill
skills.why_zh: 四条铁律里最重的一条是「绝不为凑足三个结果放宽过敏原、忌口或不可用的厨具」——宁可只给两道。
skills.why_en: The heaviest of its four hard rules: never relax an allergen, a dietary restriction or an unusable piece of equipment just to fill three slots.
skills.limit_zh: 菜谱库是打包进来的 HowToCook 离线快照，不联网，时间一长就旧，而且原仓库图片没打包、失效的相对链接一律不渲染。它明写「绝不把 AI 生成内容伪装成 HowToCook 原文」——想要 AI 自创菜的人装错了。过敏和忌口是硬过滤，凑不满三个也不放宽。
skills.limit_en: The recipe library is a bundled offline snapshot of HowToCook with no network access, so it ages, and the upstream images are not packaged — broken relative links simply are not rendered. It states outright that AI-written content must never be passed off as HowToCook original text, so anyone wanting invented dishes installed the wrong thing. Allergens and hard restrictions are never relaxed to fill out three options.
skills.title_en: Would rather offer two dishes than loosen an allergen

skills.name: whiteboard-video
skills.title_zh: 线稿只准本地模型抽、不许 AI 生成的白板手绘视频
skills.tagline_zh: 上传一张照片，它先用本地神经网络抽出线稿，再一笔一笔画出来、配一只跟着笔尖走的手。
skills.tagline_en: Hand it a photo and it pulls the line art with a local neural model, then draws it stroke by stroke with a hand trailing the pen tip — instead of asking an image model for something that merely looks hand-drawn.
skills.why_zh: 两个本地模型一个都没装时，它规定必须直接失败 —— 不许用边缘检测糊一版弱线稿交差。
skills.why_en: With neither local model installed it is required to fail outright — no edge-detection fallback, because a weak outline that looks finished is worse than an error.
skills.limit_zh: 它只是适配层：引擎要 pip 装另一个仓库，Informative Drawings 或 Anime2Sketch 至少装一个并设环境变量，而模型的安装指南在引擎仓库里、不在这一件。一个都没装时它直接失败，不给降级方案。
skills.limit_en: It is only an adapter. The engine is a separate pip install, you must set up Informative Drawings or Anime2Sketch yourself and point env vars at it, and the model setup guide lives in the engine repo rather than here. With neither installed, extract-lineart and render-photo fail outright.
skills.title_en: Refuses to let an image model draw the line art

skills.name: pet-nutritionist
skills.title_zh: 严禁给龙猫洗澡、也给矮脚马算食谱的宠物营养师
skills.tagline_zh: 兔子龙猫严禁水洗、只能沙浴，豚鼠每天得补维生素C，矮脚马每 6–8 周修一次蹄——猫狗之外那些宠物，它才是主场。
skills.tagline_en: Rabbits and chinchillas must never get wet, only sand baths. Guinea pigs need vitamin C daily. A Shetland pony needs its hooves trimmed every six to eight weeks. This one lives outside the cat-and-dog world.
skills.desc_en: 科学铲屎官 - 营养×洗护×零食玩具 | Scientific Pet Care Assistant | TRAE SOLO Skill
skills.why_zh: 它先查物种合法性：蛇、土拨鼠、狐狸一律不服务，理由是《野生动物保护法》，不是不会答。
skills.why_en: It screens the species before anything else — snakes, marmots and foxes get turned away on wildlife-law grounds, not for lack of an answer.
skills.limit_zh: 皮肤问题它一律当病症处理，直接让你去医院，不给洗护调理方案。全部本事是一段提示词加十份参考清单，不带脚本也不带计算器；喂食量要你自己报品种、月龄、体重、体况和绝育状况才算。爬行类和野生动物直接拒答。
skills.limit_en: Skin trouble is always treated as illness and sent to a vet, so there is no home-grooming fix here. The whole thing is one prompt plus ten reference sheets, with no scripts and no calculator, and it will not size a meal until you supply breed, age in months, weight, body condition and neuter status. Reptiles and wild animals are refused outright.
skills.title_en: A pet nutritionist that forbids bathing your chinchilla

skills.name: trip-map-builder
skills.title_zh: 会替你删掉一半心愿单的行程地图生成器
skills.tagline_zh: 把零散截图和收藏整理成一天一片区的行程，查完点评和小红书，输出可点导航的单页交互地图。
skills.tagline_en: Turns scattered screenshots and saved links into one-neighbourhood-per-day plans, checks dining signals, and ships a single-file interactive map with navigation and reservation buttons.
skills.desc_en: 旅行行程规划技能：规划 → 小红书调研 → 交互式地图页面 | Agent Skill for trip planning with 小红书 research and interactive map generation
skills.why_zh: 它认为你列的东西塞不进去，所以替你删；一天最多安排一个需要订位的地方。
skills.why_en: It states plainly that not everything you listed fits, and deletes for you — one area per day, at most one reservation-required stop per day, and never bend a day around a famous restaurant that's off-route.
skills.limit_zh: 调研环节绑死大众点评和小红书，非中文目的地信号很弱；要装第三方 OpenCLI 并自己开带调试端口的 Chrome；产出的地图是一份静态快照，行程当天不会自己更新。 小红书那段是在你自己开的 Chrome 里拦站内搜索接口取数，账号风险你自己担。
skills.limit_en: Research is wired to Dianping and Xiaohongshu, so non-Chinese destinations get thin signal. Needs the third-party OpenCLI plus a Chrome you launch with a debug port. The map is a static snapshot, not live. The Xiaohongshu step intercepts the site's own search API inside the Chrome you launched — the account risk is yours.
skills.title_en: The itinerary that deletes half your wishlist for you

skills.name: zhuanye-rensheng-tiyan
skills.title_zh: 禁止给薪资均值、只说「分两拨人」的专业人生模拟
skills.tagline_zh: 十分钟纯选项文字游戏，替高考生把计算机专业从大一活到 35 岁。出身在前两幕起作用，第三幕不再让它继续拉大差距。
skills.tagline_en: A ten-minute all-choices text game that walks a high-school senior through a computer science degree from freshman year to thirty-five. Background shapes the first two acts and stops widening the gap in the third.
skills.desc_en: 人生重开·选专业版 — 让高考生提前"活一遍"某专业毕业后人生的 AI 文字游戏 Skill
skills.why_zh: 铁律写着「诚实是承认牌不一样，羞辱是暗示输牌的人不配」——所以二本进外包是主干结局，不是惩罚。
skills.why_en: One rule says it plainly: honesty is admitting the hands differ, humiliation is implying whoever lost the hand deserved to. So a mid-tier school leading to outsourcing work is a main-line ending, not a punishment.
skills.limit_zh: v1 只有计算机一个专业，别的专业玩不了。正文自认「真实性此刻靠模型的行业知识加铁律兜底，还没有查证内容包」，并明说不要宣称数据权威。出身设定刻意不问性别，理由是评审认定那一项最容易翻车。
skills.limit_en: Version one covers computer science only; no other major is playable. The file admits its realism currently rests on the model's industry knowledge plus its own guardrails, with no verified content pack yet, and says not to claim the numbers are authoritative. It also deliberately never asks your gender, because reviewers judged that variable the easiest one to get wrong.
skills.title_en: Refuses to quote an average salary, only "two groups of people"

skills.name: pocket-book-generator
skills.title_zh: 奇数页孔在左偶数页在右，把攻略印成活页手账
skills.tagline_zh: 攻略存在手机里，玩到一半总要切出去看。它排成 95×170 的活页尺寸，正反面镜像打孔，长边翻转后孔位正好重合。
skills.tagline_en: Your walkthrough lives on your phone and you keep switching away mid-game. This lays it out at 95 by 170 mm for a pocket binder, mirroring the punch margin so the holes line up after a long-edge flip.
skills.desc_en: 游戏攻略活页手账生成器
skills.why_zh: 双面打印的孔位对齐是用 CSS 奇偶页选择器把打孔区左右互换做出来的，不靠你手工对页。
skills.why_en: Hole alignment on duplex printing comes from CSS odd/even page selectors swapping the punch zone left and right — not from you eyeballing the second pass.
skills.limit_zh: 它只解决排版：纸得你自己裁、孔得你自己打、活页夹自己买。输出路径写死在 /mnt/kimi/output/，是照 Kimi 沙箱写的，换别的 agent 要改。字体走 CDN 拉霞鹜文楷，打印前得先联网让它缓存好，Safari 打印还可能要调设置。
skills.limit_en: It only does layout: you cut the paper, punch the holes and buy the binder. The output path is hard-coded to a Kimi sandbox directory and needs changing on any other agent. The Chinese font loads from a CDN, so print only after it has cached, and Safari may need print settings adjusted.
skills.title_en: Odd pages punch left, even pages punch right

skills.name: bzd-review-paper
skills.title_zh: 就算无可挑剔也只给 90 分的数模国赛评委
skills.tagline_zh: 交进完整赛题和论文，它先自己立一张 100 分评分表并冻结，再逐条打分，最后估出你超过多少比例的有效参赛论文。
skills.tagline_en: Hand it the full contest problem and your paper. It builds and freezes its own hundred-point rubric before reading for quality, scores criterion by criterion, then estimates what share of valid entries you would beat.
skills.desc_en: 数学建模竞赛论文智能评审 Skill，支持 Codex 与 Claude Code，使用近五年国赛评阅细则、评分要点、评分概述等文件以及对应赛题进行蒸馏，并将真正在主观评审中涉及到的各种因素考虑在内，较为完备的复刻完整的评审流程，以便大家能够对自己的论文有较好的定位。
skills.why_zh: 每个计分项一律 0.9×权重封顶，原始满分只有 90；正文要求把这笔写成「评委满分保留」，不是论文缺陷。
skills.why_en: Every numeric criterion is capped at nine tenths of its weight, so the raw maximum is ninety — and the file insists that deduction be labelled a judge's reserve rather than a defect in the paper.
skills.limit_zh: 报告末尾会被强制插入作者社群的 QQ 群号和微信号，正文原话是要求「保留其措辞、强调、顺序和换行」。评分表蒸馏自 2020–2025 十六道国赛题的评阅细则，非国赛一律走「小型竞赛」近似分布，位次只是估算不是名次。
skills.limit_en: The report is required to end with the author's QQ group numbers and WeChat IDs, preserving their wording, emphasis, order and line breaks. The rubric is distilled from the official grading notes for sixteen CUMCM problems between 2020 and 2025; every other contest routes to a rough small-field distribution, and the percentile is an estimate, not a rank.
skills.title_en: Caps a flawless paper at ninety out of a hundred

skills.name: bluey-parenting
skills.title_zh: 先让你冷水冲手腕 10 秒，再翻《布鲁伊》第几集
skills.tagline_zh: 「我又吼了他」——这时它不讲道理，先给一个 30 秒能做完的动作，再翻出班迪特也敷衍过孩子的那一集，标上季集号。
skills.tagline_en: "I yelled at him again." At that point it skips the reasoning, gives you one thing you can do in thirty seconds, then pulls up the episode where Bandit also fobbed his kids off — with the season and number.
skills.desc_en: 布鲁伊父母支持 - 基于Bluey动画片的育儿支持Coze技能
skills.why_zh: 四种入口走四条路：要点子的那一路明写「不先共情，直接给游戏」，五分钟能准备好。
skills.why_en: Four entry points, four different routes. The one for parents who just want an idea says outright: skip the empathy, hand over the game, five minutes of prep.
skills.limit_zh: 它的主要语料是一部动画片——没看过《布鲁伊》的人，剧集对照那一半是空的。心理学补位只在 P.E.T.、依恋理论、Gottman 等七个框架里选，必须写出提出者，「心理学研究表明」这种说法被禁掉了。剧集链接指向 B 站正版，要能访问才用得上。
skills.limit_en: Its main corpus is a cartoon, so half of it is empty if you have never watched Bluey. Psychology only fills gaps from seven named frameworks — P.E.T., attachment theory, Gottman and others — and must name whoever proposed it, with vague phrasing like "studies show" banned outright. Episode links point to the licensed Bilibili stream, which you need to be able to reach.
skills.title_en: Cold water on your wrists for ten seconds, then which Bluey episode

skills.name: huashu-slide-doubao
skills.title_zh: 用豆包自带生图出整套 PPT，一分第三方 API 钱不花
skills.tagline_zh: 做课件、公众号头图、B站封面都得掏生图 API 的钱。它把这步锁死在豆包内置 seedream 上，还给封面、扉页、内容页、结论页各配一条密度上限。
skills.tagline_en: Course decks, WeChat headers and Bilibili thumbnails all bill you per generated image. This one pins that step to Doubao's built-in seedream, and gives covers, section breaks, content pages and closers four separate density ceilings.
skills.desc_en: 豆包环境专用的视觉物料生产：PPT / Keynote / HTML deck、公众号封面与正文配图、B站/YouTube 视频封面。存在的全部理由是走豆包内置 image_gen（默认 seedream_5.0_pro 模型），不花第三方图像 API 的钱——不在豆包环境就别用。用户说做PPT、幻灯片、演示文稿、deck、公众号封面、视频封面时触发。
skills.why_zh: 它给字数上限配了反向约束：正文明写「AI 看到 220 字上限就会朝 220 字写」，于是先逼你答这页要人记住哪一句。
skills.why_en: The word ceiling comes with a counterweight: the text warns that a model told "220 characters max" will write to 220, so every page must first name the one line the audience should remember.
skills.limit_zh: 不在豆包环境就别装——作者写明它「存在的全部理由」就是豆包自带的 image_gen，默认的 seedream_5.0_pro 还是会员专属，非会员回退 4.5。产物默认是图片式 PPT，文字不可编辑，除非你明说要可编辑、或生图连挂三次。
skills.limit_en: Don't install this outside Doubao — the author calls the built-in image_gen its entire reason to exist, and the default seedream_5.0_pro is members-only, falling back to 4.5 for everyone else. Slides come out as flat images with no editable text unless you explicitly ask for editable output, or generation fails three times.
skills.title_en: Whole decks from Doubao's built-in image model, with no image API bill

skills.name: bro
skills.title_zh: 重讲一遍但一个数字都不许改的 /bro
skills.tagline_zh: 上一条回答没看懂就打 /bro，它把自己刚说的话换成人话重说一次，不回答新问题、不查资料。
skills.tagline_en: Type /bro when the last answer didn't land, and it re-explains its own previous message like it's talking to a smart friend over a beer.
skills.desc_en: 🤙 /bro — re-explains the last answer in plain language, for when the reply made you go 'bro what'. One-file skill for Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, and opencode.
skills.why_zh: 路径、命令、数字、URL 全部原样保留：只简化解释，不简化事实。
skills.why_en: Every path, command, filename, number and URL survives verbatim — it simplifies the explanation around the facts, never the facts. And simpler doesn't mean shorter.
skills.limit_zh: 全文 1.6KB，没有任何脚本；它只重述上一条助手消息，你要是想追问新东西它不接；对话里没有上一条时它只会说现在没什么可简化的。
skills.limit_en: 1.6KB, no scripts. It only re-expresses the previous assistant message: no new questions, no tools, no fresh information. With no prior message it just says there's nothing to simplify yet.
skills.title_en: Say it again, and don't touch a single number

skills.name: nuyoah-xiezhen-prompt
skills.title_zh: 分得清皮肤纹理和皮肤反光的写真提示词
skills.tagline_zh: 按妆容、发服、道具、构图、镜头、动作、光线的固定顺序推导，也能把参考图拆回可复用的词链。
skills.tagline_en: Derives portrait prompts in a fixed order — makeup, hair and wardrobe, props, composition, lens, pose, light, scene — or reverse-engineers a reference image back into a reusable keyword chain.
skills.desc_en: 南鸢写真提示词 Agent Skill
skills.why_zh: 「真实皮肤微纹理」替代不了底妆干湿和 T 区油光，它按景别单独控反光范围。
skills.why_en: 'Realistic micro skin texture' does not substitute for how wet the base makeup is or where the T-zone shines, so it controls highlight width per shot size instead of defaulting everything to matte.
skills.limit_zh: 默认只交付中文提示词、不主动生图；默认对象是成年年轻女性写真；同系列变体只固定风格与成像词链，构图动作每张重做，想要完全一致的连拍它给不了。
skills.limit_en: Delivers Chinese prompts only and won't generate images unless asked. Default subject is an adult young woman. Series variants lock only style and imaging chains — composition and pose are redesigned each frame, so it can't give you an identical set.
skills.title_en: It knows skin texture and skin reflection are different problems

skills.name: surreal-pop-collage
skills.title_zh: 全图只许有一处不对劲的超现实拼贴台
skills.tagline_zh: 把你的照片去色留作现实锚点，背景换成两三块巨大平涂色形，再放进唯一一个不可能的巨物。
skills.tagline_en: Desaturates your photo into a black-and-white reality anchor, replaces the world behind it with two or three huge flat colour shapes, then drops in exactly one impossible object.
skills.desc_en: 把照片变成超现实波普拼贴的 AI agent skill：黑白现实锚点 + 平涂色形 + 全图只有一个不可能的巨物。An agent skill that turns photos into surreal pop collages.
skills.why_zh: 禁止默认红日蓝天，禁止默认海豚鲸鱼：照抄参考图就是抄袭。
skills.why_en: The whole force of the surreal is that only one thing is wrong. A second impossible element gets deleted, and every colour must trace back to a hue already in your photo.
skills.limit_zh: 它只写提示词并调用你接的生图服务，成品好坏取决于那个模型；默认竖版 3:4；中文不许进 prompt（必乱码），文字要后期另排；纠偏只允许重生成一次。
skills.limit_en: It writes the prompt and calls whatever image model you've wired up — output quality is that model's. Vertical 3:4 by default. Chinese text must be composited afterward, never put in the prompt. One retry only.
skills.title_en: One impossible giant, and nothing else out of place

skills.name: money-find
skills.title_zh: 拒绝把「教你赚钱」的帖子当依据的副业侦察
skills.tagline_zh: 只看招聘、采购、政策这类利益中立的需求信号反推机会，每条再过一遍反诈和时效两道 rubric。
skills.tagline_en: Works backwards from interest-neutral demand signals — job postings, procurement, policy — into things you could actually supply, then runs every candidate through an anti-scam and a freshness rubric.
skills.desc_en: AI 时代靠谱兼职发现 + 反诈验证 skill：需求信号反推 + 实时时效核查 + 反诈 rubric + 个性化校准环
skills.why_zh: 没人会把真能赚钱的方法发到教你赚钱的帖里，那类内容是卖课钓粉漏斗。
skills.why_en: Its founding claim: nobody posts a method that actually makes money into a 'how to get rich' thread — that content is a course-selling funnel, so it isn't a source.
skills.limit_zh: 六个 money-* 子命令是一条流水线，要整仓安装并先跑 money-init 建画像；闲鱼和 BOSS 的一手数据靠你自己开 Chrome 登录、滑块自己过；找不到靠谱机会时它就直说没找到。
skills.limit_en: Six money-* commands form one pipeline; install the whole repo and run money-init first. First-party marketplace and hiring data comes from a Chrome you log into and clear sliders in yourself. When it finds nothing credible, it says so.
skills.title_en: It won't cite a 'how to make money online' post as evidence

skills.name: english-coach
skills.title_zh: 先把你的问题答完才回头纠语法的英语教练
skills.tagline_zh: 每条回复三段：正常回答，五条以内的错误订正，一条轮换的新表达或语法点，重复犯的会被标成惯性错误。
skills.tagline_en: Every reply has three parts: the actual answer, at most five corrections in strikethrough-to-bold form with a category tag, and one rotating thing to learn.
skills.desc_en: Claude Code skill for learning English through real conversations, corrections, and micro-lessons.
skills.why_zh: 它先做正事：英语纠错是附赠，不是主菜；一次最多改五处，多了就说省略了几处小问题。
skills.why_en: It puts the coaching second on purpose — do your actual job first, the English is a bonus — and caps corrections at five so a reply never turns into a red-pen page.
skills.limit_zh: 全文不到 3KB，没有脚本也没有进度存档，「适应你的水平」全靠同一段对话的上下文，换新会话就从零开始；只教英语对话，不适合代码审查和技术文档。
skills.limit_en: Under 3KB, no scripts, no stored progress. 'Adapts to your level' means within one conversation; a new session starts cold. Conversation English only — explicitly not for code reviews or technical docs.
skills.title_en: The English coach that answers your question first

skills.name: apple-health-analyst
skills.title_zh: 故意把综合健康分留成空值的健康报告
skills.tagline_zh: 本地解析 Apple 健康导出，出一份健康报告和一份训练报告，每条结论都必须引到具体数值或日期。
skills.tagline_en: Parses your Apple Health export locally into structured insights, then writes two cross-linked HTML reports — health and training — where every conclusion has to cite a real number or date.
skills.desc_en: Privacy-conscious Apple Health export analyzer with bilingual health and multi-sport training reports
skills.why_zh: 复合评分字段一律留 null：不许用消费级设备的杂糅指标编一个健康总分。
skills.why_en: compositeAssessment stays null on purpose: do not invent a single health score out of heterogeneous consumer-device metrics, and don't pretend to be a coach writing a periodised plan.
skills.limit_zh: 要你自己从 iPhone 导出 zip 并装它的 npx 包；明确不做诊断、不推药物治疗或补剂剂量；睡眠分期、血氧、VO2max 一律当估计值；只有健康与训练两份报告，没有饮食营养。
skills.limit_en: You export the zip from your iPhone and install its npx package. It explicitly won't diagnose, name a condition, or recommend medication, treatment or supplement doses. Sleep stages, SpO2 and VO2max are treated as estimates. No nutrition.
skills.title_en: The health report that leaves the composite score deliberately null

skills.name: backend-agent-project-selector
skills.title_zh: 不许把「建议改造」写成「已完成」的简历项目侦察兵
skills.tagline_zh: 它不替你写简历。它从 GitHub 挑一个你真该动手改的业务系统，clone 到本地读源码，再告诉你哪几条能写进简历。
skills.tagline_en: It does not write your resume. It goes out to GitHub, finds one complete business system worth your actually modifying, clones it locally to read the source, then tells you which bullets you can already claim and which you have to build first.
skills.desc_en: 一个Skill，主要目标是为后端和 AI Agent 求职者，从 GitHub 里筛出真正能写进简历、能经得起面试追问的项目，并基于源码证据生成简历项目包
skills.why_zh: star 过 1k 就不再因更高而加分；本地 clone 不成功、源码里抠不出 5 个证据点的一律淘汰。
skills.why_en: Past a thousand stars, more stars earn nothing extra. Any candidate it cannot clone locally, or from whose source it cannot extract five concrete evidence points, is eliminated outright.
skills.limit_zh: 只服务后端（Java/Spring、分布式）和业务型 AI Agent 两个方向，默认排除 IoT 与嵌入式；前端、算法、非技术岗用不上。它交的不是文档而是工程作业——推荐的项目你得真去改，是几周的活。必须联网、必须 git clone，你不先选一种推荐模式它就不动。
skills.limit_en: Scoped to backend work (Java/Spring, distributed systems) and business-grade AI agents, with IoT and embedded excluded by default — no use for frontend, algorithms or non-technical roles. What it delivers is homework, not a document: the project it picks is weeks of real work. It needs the network, needs git clone, and refuses to start until you pick one of its recommendation modes.
skills.title_en: The resume project scout that will not let a plan be written up as done

skills.name: csp
skills.title_zh: 只写「她会怎么反应」不抄台词的角色蒸馏器
skills.tagline_zh: 本地脚本检索萌娘百科等站点，五路并行调研，交叉验证后蒸出三到七条可执行的行为规则。
skills.tagline_en: Runs local scripted retrieval over character wikis, five parallel research agents, cross-validates every load-bearing claim, then distils three to seven executable behaviour rules.
skills.desc_en: Character Skill Producer — distill anime characters into executable agent skills
skills.why_zh: 它抓的是她怎么行动，不是她说过什么：标签给人看，行为规则给 AI 执行。
skills.why_en: The stated distinction: capture HOW she behaves, not WHAT she said — tags are for humans, behaviour rules are for the agent to run. Anything it can't ground stays a declared boundary.
skills.limit_zh: 要 Python，且默认只跑最高保真模式，很费 token；来源黑名单排除知乎、公众号和百度百科；生成的角色包会写死资料截止日期，作品一出新剧情就得重跑。
skills.limit_en: Needs Python and runs highest-fidelity mode only, which burns tokens. Zhihu, WeChat articles and Baidu Baike are blacklisted as sources. Every generated pack stamps a data cutoff date and needs a rerun when the work updates.
skills.title_en: It writes how she behaves, not what she said

skills.name: xbloom-studio-recipe
skills.title_zh: 翻车只准改一个变量的 xBloom 冲煮配方
skills.tagline_zh: 一杯不对味就想同时调三个旋钮。它按屏显比粉床高 2–4℃ 折算温度，再给三条修正路线，每条只准动一个变量。
skills.tagline_en: A cup tastes off and the urge is to change three dials at once. This converts display temperature to bed temperature, then hands you three fixes, each touching exactly one variable.
skills.desc_en: 根据咖啡豆参数生成可直接填入 xBloom Studio App 的设备约束冲煮方案。
skills.why_zh: 每个数都压在机器的真实上限里：磨 1–80、转速只走 60 到 120 的十档、流速 3.0–3.5。
skills.why_en: Every value is clamped to what the machine actually accepts: grind 1–80, RPM only in tens from 60 to 120, flow 3.0–3.5 ml/s.
skills.limit_zh: 没有 xBloom Studio 这台机器，整份输出没有一个数字用得上——档位、转速、振动全按它 App 的字段写。正文自己承认屏显温度不等于粉床温度，只能按低 2–4℃ 估。机器报 WAIT 时它先让你去看秤上的胶带撕没撕、杯子有没有贴着机身。
skills.limit_en: Without an xBloom Studio, not one number here is usable — grind, RPM and vibration are written against its app fields. The file admits display temperature is not bed temperature and can only be estimated 2–4°C lower. When the machine throws WAIT, it first tells you to check whether the tape came off the scale.
skills.title_en: One variable per fix, for xBloom Studio brews

skills.name: fridge-hero
skills.title_zh: 拿黄曲霉毒素耐热 280℃ 劝你扔掉的冰箱清道夫
skills.tagline_zh: 「坏了一点还能吃吧」——它专治这个侥幸：霉斑切掉周围仍有毒素，久泡木耳的米酵菌酸致死率过半，蛤蜊焯水不开口就是死的。
skills.tagline_en: "It's only a little off, right?" That's the hope it exists to kill: cutting mould out leaves toxin behind, long-soaked wood ear can carry a toxin that kills half the people it poisons, and a clam that stays shut after blanching was already dead.
skills.desc_en: 冰箱清道夫 - 剩余食材创意菜谱×鉴鲜×储存×处理 | Fridge Hero | TRAE SOLO Skill
skills.why_zh: 红色档一律不给「补救方案」——它拒绝把变质食材写进任何一道菜，这是硬约束不是提醒。
skills.why_en: Anything flagged red gets no rescue recipe at all. Refusing to put spoiled food into a dish is a hard constraint here, not a reminder.
skills.limit_zh: 野生菌和河豚它一律拒绝处理，不给做法。判断新鲜全靠你自己描述颜色、气味、触感——它看不见东西，隔着一层描述做食品安全判断。相克那一节是反着写的：螃蟹柿子、菠菜豆腐都被它当谣言辟掉，跟长辈的说法会正面冲突。
skills.limit_en: Wild mushrooms and pufferfish are refused outright, with no method given. Every freshness call rests on your own description of colour, smell and texture — it cannot see anything, so it is judging food safety at one remove. The food-incompatibility section runs the other way, dismissing crab-with-persimmon and spinach-with-tofu as myths, which will put you head to head with your elders.
skills.title_en: The fridge cleaner that talks you into throwing it out

skills.name: family-history-planning
skills.title_zh: 你一说出祖先名字它就拒绝立刻开搜
skills.tagline_zh: 先问你已知什么、想证明什么，排出档案优先级和检索策略，你点头之后才准动手查第一条记录。
skills.tagline_en: Asks what you already know and what you're trying to prove, builds a prioritised research plan with citation and evidence-analysis templates, and only then executes searches — logging negative results too.
skills.desc_en: A Claude Skill to assist with family history and genealogy research planning.
skills.why_zh: 「绝对禁止未经要求的网络搜索」：它认为族谱的价值在方法，不在抢先翻出一张表。
skills.why_en: It says the value of genealogy is systematic planning, not rushing to find records, and forbids unsolicited searching outright.
skills.limit_zh: 方法与引用格式偏美国族谱学传统（Evidence Explained、GPS 五要素），资源首推 FamilySearch 与 LDSgenealogy；中文族谱、地方志和东亚档案基本不在它的地图里。
skills.limit_en: The method and citation style are US-genealogy tradition (Evidence Explained, the GPS five elements), and it points first at FamilySearch and LDSgenealogy. East Asian clan books and local gazetteers are outside its map.
skills.title_en: Say an ancestor's name and it refuses to start searching

skills.name: legal-language-bridge
skills.title_zh: 把「定金」和「订金」两个字掰开算钱的维权翻译机
skills.tagline_zh: 你说「公司无故辞退我」，它输出能提交的仲裁申诉文本，附证据清单、维权路径和赔偿估算。覆盖劳动、租房、预付卡等 15 类。
skills.tagline_en: Say "my company fired me for no reason" and it hands back a filable arbitration statement, plus the evidence you need to keep, the route to take, and a compensation range. Fifteen domains, from labour to tenancy to prepaid cards that vanished.
skills.desc_en: 将普通人日常表达转化为专业法律语言，使生成的内容可直接用于法律文书、劳动仲裁申请、消费投诉、对外交涉等场景。同时提供反向翻译功能，将法律文书中的法言法语解读为通俗易懂的大白话。  本版本新增： 四个新场景（医疗/教培/保险/预付卡）、维权路径地图、证据清单、赔偿计算器、常见误区纠正、合同条款逐条解读、判决书摘要、双模式翻译引擎。  核心理念： 本 Skill 不是法律咨询工具，不替代律师。它帮助用
skills.why_zh: 误区表逐条对撞常识：定金不退订金可退，食品假货是退一赔十，2N 和 N 不能同时主张。
skills.why_en: Its misconception table collides with common sense line by line: one kind of deposit is forfeit and the other refundable, counterfeit food pays ten times over, and you cannot claim both severance and the double-damages figure.
skills.limit_zh: 中国大陆法律，条文和赔偿标准会随司法解释变动，正文明写不构成法律意见、不替代律师。赔偿计算器只给区间，各省的一次性伤残就业补助金标准要你自己查。合同逐条解读这一块和在架的 AnythingButLaw 有重叠。
skills.limit_en: Mainland Chinese law only, and the statutes and compensation standards shift with judicial interpretation — the skill states outright that it is not legal advice and no substitute for a lawyer. The calculator gives ranges; province-specific disability employment subsidies you look up yourself. Its clause-by-clause contract reading overlaps with AnythingButLaw, already on the shelf.
skills.title_en: The grievance translator that pries apart two nearly identical Chinese words for deposit

skills.name: gaokao-advisor
skills.title_zh: 按经济下行期算账、和招生办天然对立的志愿顾问
skills.tagline_zh: 市面上都是算分匹配器，它做没人碰的那部分调查：这校给分压不压、导师有没有 PUA、分配看不看关系、进去每天过什么样
skills.tagline_en: The market is full of score matchers. This one does the part nobody touches: does this school mark you down, do the supervisors bully, are placements decided by connections, what does a day there actually feel like.
skills.desc_en: 站在孩子和家长一边的高考志愿决策 Agent Skill
skills.why_zh: 一条元铁律焊死：不裁决只呈现，措辞里出现「一票否决」「完美契合」「量身定制」就自己改掉。
skills.why_en: One overriding rule: present, never adjudicate. Phrasing like "ruled out", "perfect fit" or "tailored for you" gets rewritten by the skill itself.
skills.limit_zh: 它带一整份「功利现实手册」，会把女孩选专业的婚恋算计照实端给家长，并明说不做道德评判——受不了这套的别装。志愿表要填到该省志愿数的七成以上，位次、名额、就业数字全靠现场联网核，查不到就标「待核」，不靠记忆答。
skills.limit_en: It carries a whole cynical-realities handbook and will hand parents the marriage-market arithmetic behind a daughter's choice of major, stating plainly that it passes no moral judgement — if that turns your stomach, do not install it. The list has to be filled to at least seventy percent of your province's slots, and every rank, quota and employment figure is verified live or marked unconfirmed rather than answered from memory.
skills.title_en: College-application advice priced for a downturn, structurally against the admissions office

skills.name: xianyu-monitor
skills.title_zh: 撞上滑块就停手、绝不替你出价的闲鱼蹲货员
skills.tagline_zh: 关键词、价格、地区筛完自动去重，最短半小时一轮盯上新，成色和信誉一律标成未知，不替你猜。
skills.tagline_en: Recurring keyword searches on China's biggest used-goods market, with price and region filters, dedup across runs, and a hard 30-minute floor on polling.
skills.desc_en: Cross-host Agent Skill for Xianyu/Goofish (闲鱼) listing search and monitoring: keyword, price/location filters, pagination, deduplication, and persistent tasks.
skills.why_zh: 同类爬虫都在装成人类，它写明遇到验证码就停、不换身份、不重复硬试。
skills.why_en: Its own rule: stop on risk control, do not bypass, do not rotate identity. Condition and seller reputation stay 'unknown' unless captured evidence proves them.
skills.limit_zh: 只覆盖闲鱼一家。要在它单独开的浏览器里手动扫码登录，滑块也得你自己过；轮询最短 30 分钟，秒杀捡漏用不上；它不发消息、不下单、不付款。
skills.limit_en: Xianyu/Goofish only. You log in yourself in a dedicated Playwright window and clear any slider by hand; 30-minute minimum interval rules out flash-deal sniping; it never messages, bids, or pays.
skills.title_en: The Xianyu watcher that stops dead at the CAPTCHA instead of dodging it

skills.name: professor-skill
skills.title_zh: 把「这题上课讲过」蒸成一份期末自救包
skills.tagline_zh: 课件、真题、群里问答分两条线走：一条抽考试范围和给分偏好，一条抽这位老师的说话方式。
skills.tagline_en: Splits your course materials into two engines — a Course Brain for exam scope, question patterns and grading preferences, and a Teacher Persona for how this specific lecturer actually talks.
skills.desc_en: 把不会划重点的老师，蒸馏成会救你期末的 Skill. Distill course materials into professor-style review, question patterns, and grading hints.
skills.why_zh: 分工写得很清楚：人格决定语气，课程大脑决定内容；玩笑只能来自认得出，不能是随口段子。
skills.why_en: The division of labour is explicit: persona decides tone, Course Brain decides substance. And humour must come from recognition, never from random jokes.
skills.limit_zh: 要你自己手里有课件和真题，材料薄它会明说置信度低；老师是真人，导入私聊记录和课堂录音你未必有权；它禁止把生成内容说成老师的正式通知或评分规则。
skills.limit_en: You need real materials; thin input gets an honest low-confidence label. Your professor is a real person, and you may not have the right to ingest private chat logs or recordings. It refuses to pass output off as official notices or grading rules.
skills.title_en: Distils 'we covered this in class' into an exam rescue kit

skills.name: trpg-log-copilot
skills.title_zh: 只读最后三行、绝不通读全档的跑团档案副官
skills.tagline_zh: 跑到第十次团，线索、NPC 和 SAN 值散在十份记录对不上。它把表写进 Markdown，检索交给 SQLite。
skills.tagline_en: Ten sessions in, your clues, NPCs and sanity totals sit in ten files that no longer agree. This writes tables into Markdown, hands querying to a local SQLite, and keeps dice and dashboard on your machine.
skills.desc_en: CodeBuddy SKILL — TRPG 跑团副官：车卡、日志归档、线索分析、防超游。支持 CoC/DND 多规则，零依赖即用。
skills.why_zh: 写入只追加 Markdown、查询只走 SQL，写坏一行只坏一行——为的是不像 JSON 整份报废。
skills.why_en: Writes append to Markdown, reads go through SQL, so one bad row stays one bad row — the file says that is the point, unlike a JSON blob that dies whole.
skills.limit_zh: 名字是它唯一的跨文件索引键，写简称或错一个字就断联，NPC 和线索接不上。它是玩家侧的副官，不主持、不替角色做决定，想找人开团的别装。跑起来要 Python 和 SQLite，还得先用内置模板生成一份项目级规则再用。
skills.limit_en: Names are its only cross-file index key: a nickname or one wrong character breaks the link and NPCs stop matching their clues. It sits on the player's side of the table — it does not run the game or decide for your character, so it is no use if you wanted a Keeper. Running it needs Python and SQLite, plus one setup pass to generate the project-level rule from its template.
skills.title_en: Reads the last three rows and never the whole archive

skills.name: health-report-trend-analysis
skills.title_zh: OCR 抠出来的数不许参与涨跌判定的体检趋势台
skills.tagline_zh: 把历年体检报告（电子 PDF、扫描件、手机拍的照片）解析成指标时间序列，标出异常和趋好趋坏，出报告加一张离线工作台。
skills.tagline_en: It parses years of health checkup reports — text PDFs, scans, even phone photos — into one indicator time series, flags what is abnormal, what moved significantly, and which way it is heading, then ships a report and an offline dashboard.
skills.desc_en: 体检指标趋势分析系统：多年度体检报告统一解析为标准化指标时间序列，产出趋势报告与离线健康工作台（Agent Skills）
skills.why_zh: 异常判定用当年报告自带的参考范围，不跨年套统一值——试剂一换，直接胆红素的上下限就变了。
skills.why_en: Abnormality is judged against the reference range printed on that year's own report, never a single range imposed across years — swap the reagent and the direct bilirubin bounds move with it.
skills.limit_zh: 电子版解析的列坐标是照某一家体检机构的版式实测出来的，换机构要先自己确认列边界。照片版靠 macOS Vision OCR，非 Mac 走不了这条路，而且照片里的中文识别率不到一半。给的是分层建议和就医指征，不给诊断也不给药。
skills.limit_en: The column coordinates for text PDFs were measured against one particular clinic's layout, so a different provider means confirming the boundaries yourself first. The photo path runs on macOS Vision OCR, which rules out non-Mac machines, and Chinese recognition on photos lands under fifty percent. You get tiered lifestyle guidance and referral thresholds — no diagnosis, no drugs.
skills.title_en: The checkup trend desk that bars OCR-scraped numbers from any change verdict

skills.name: ai-therapy
skills.title_zh: 你没说再见就走，下次开场前它悄悄补完上次的账
skills.tagline_zh: 「我感觉这个函数有问题」不进入咨询——它按「说事还是说人」判触发，因为误触发不只是回应不合适，会污染档案。
skills.tagline_en: "I think this function has a bug" does not open a session. It routes on whether you are describing a thing or describing yourself, because a false trigger does not just answer badly — it contaminates the file.
skills.desc_en: InnerGuide 是一个支持 IFS/躯体/CBT/ACT/叙事疗法的 AI 咨询 Skill，能根据来访者状态动态切换流派姿态。跨会话长期记忆，身体感受优先，认知分析靠后——就像一个有 20 年经验的咨询师坐在你对面，安静地听，好奇地问，不急着给答案。全部数据本地存储，无服务器上传。
skills.why_zh: 用户看完回复就走是常态，所以它把「补账」做成启动动作，还规定不许提「你上次没说再见」。
skills.why_en: People read the reply and walk off, so reconciling the unwritten record is a startup step — and it is forbidden to mention that you left.
skills.limit_zh: 热线是中国大陆的 12356 和 120，正文自己写着「若来访者不在中国大陆，本节必须整体替换成当地资源」。四个流派姿态每次只加载一个，切换靠累计咨询日与 21 天计时，不是你随时能点的开关。陪伴回应常态 150 字以内。
skills.limit_en: Hotlines are mainland China (12356, 120); the file itself says the section must be replaced wholesale for anyone outside. Only one of the four therapeutic stances loads per session, and switching runs off a session count and a 21-day timer rather than a toggle you can flip. Companion replies stay under 150 characters.
skills.title_en: You leave without saying goodbye; it quietly closes the books

skills.name: crucial-conversations
skills.title_zh: 说完数字就闭嘴，别自己补一句「不行也没关系」
skills.tagline_zh: 提加薪、提离职、给下属负反馈、跟父母谈催婚、跟伴侣分家务。没谈的替你排练，谈崩的替你复盘，写好没敢发的那段替你改两版。
skills.tagline_en: Asking for a raise, resigning, delivering bad feedback, fending off parents about marriage, splitting housework. It rehearses the conversation you have not had, autopsies the one that blew up, and rewrites the message you drafted but could not send.
skills.desc_en: 给 AI Agent 用的中文 skill：提加薪、提离职、拒绝不合理需求、给下属负反馈、报告项目延期、伴侣家务分工、父母催婚——帮你准备能照着念的开场白，复盘吵崩的聊天记录，改写发不出去的邮件。支持 Claude Code / Codex / Copilot CLI / Gemini CLI / DeepSeek Harness。
skills.why_zh: 改写只给两版并各标代价，逼你想清要的是一个态度还是一个日期——前者对方给不了也不想给。
skills.why_en: Rewrites always come in two versions with the cost of each spelled out, which forces you to decide whether you want an attitude or a date — because the first is something the other person cannot and will not give.
skills.limit_zh: 只给文字，不代发。遇到家暴、人身威胁、自伤，它明确不套用自己那套工具（前提是双方安全对等，此处不成立），先给安全预案和 12338，并告诉你对方停不停手不取决于你的措辞。劳动仲裁只帮你准备怎么说。和在架的非暴力沟通教练在「怎么开口」上有交集。
skills.limit_en: Text only; it never sends anything for you. For domestic violence, threats or self-harm it explicitly refuses to apply its own toolkit — those tools assume two parties are safe and equal — and instead gives a safety plan, a hotline, and the line that whether the other person stops is not decided by your wording. For arbitration it only helps you prepare what to say. Overlaps with the nonviolent-communication coach already on the shelf.
skills.title_en: Say the number, then stop talking — do not add "of course it's fine if you can't"

skills.name: english-podcast-speaking-coach
skills.title_zh: 借提示说对了就不算你会的英语口语教练
skills.tagline_zh: 拿播客课文练口语。它不先讲后练：每题只给中文意图和必要场景词，让你直接开口，讲解永远发生在你说错之后。
skills.tagline_en: Practise speaking off podcast transcripts like EnglishPod. No lecture first: each prompt gives the intent in Chinese plus any words you would need, you speak, and the explanation only arrives after you miss.
skills.desc_en: 一个把播客材料转化成口语练习的 skill
skills.why_zh: 它把掌握分三档：无提示新情境说出来才算会，借了关键词、句框或刚被提醒就说对的，都记成「辅助完成」。
skills.why_en: Mastery is graded in three tiers, and only unprompted use in a genuinely new situation counts as knowing it. A keyword, a sentence frame, or getting it right just after a correction all land in "assisted".
skills.limit_zh: 它明确不管听力、发音、重音、语调和跟读，正文写着这些不在范围内，音频课本你得自己有。出题的翻译或场景词有错时它先认错、那题不算你失败——也就是说题面质量全靠模型自己把住。
skills.limit_en: It explicitly does not cover listening, pronunciation, stress, intonation or shadowing, and says so — you bring the audio material yourself. When a prompt's translation or supporting words are wrong it takes the blame and the item does not count against you, which also means prompt quality rests entirely on the model.
skills.title_en: If a hint got you there, it does not count as knowing it

skills.name: anki
skills.title_zh: 你不点头一张都不写进 Anki 的闪卡生成器
skills.tagline_zh: 把你在学的东西变成卡片写进 Anki 牌组。挖空有一档只露形状不露字：光速那串数字有几位看得见，数字本身看不见。
skills.tagline_en: Turns whatever you are studying into cards and writes them straight into a deck over AnkiConnect. Cloze has a mode that shows shape but not text — you can see how many digits the speed of light has, without seeing the digits.
skills.desc_en: Anki add-on for Markdown notes with syntax highlighting powered by Shiki
skills.why_zh: 「加卡前先把卡全摊给你看，等你说 yes」被写成不可协商——这正是 AI 批量造卡最容易糊过去的一步。
skills.why_en: "Never add cards without explicit user approval" is written as non-negotiable, with every proposed card shown in full first — exactly the step bulk card generation usually skips.
skills.limit_zh: 得先装 Anki 桌面版、开 AnkiConnect，还得装这个仓库自带的 Anki Markdown 笔记类型——三样缺一样就跑不起来。删卡、改卡、评分各要单独确认一次。示例几乎全是代码和技术词，拿来学语言得自己重写卡面规范。
skills.limit_en: You need Anki desktop running, AnkiConnect enabled, and the repo's own Anki Markdown note type installed; miss one and nothing works. Delete, update and rate each ask for their own confirmation. The examples lean almost entirely on code and technical terms, so language learners will want to rewrite the card conventions.
skills.title_en: Writes nothing into Anki until you say yes

skills.name: work-powers-shanghai
skills.title_zh: 门禁被关了也让你去打卡，被拦就报警拿回执
skills.tagline_zh: 公司停你岗、降你薪、关你门禁，它不劝你忍。今天去打卡留痕，本周寄出恢复劳动条件通知书，再按 2N 而不是 N 算钱。
skills.tagline_en: When the company benches you, cuts your pay and shuts off your badge, this does not tell you to sit tight. Clock in today for the record, send the formal demand letter this week, then compute the money at double severance rather than single.
skills.desc_en: 上海劳动维权智能助手 - 专为上海劳动者打造的 AI 维权顾问。一键安装 Claude Skill，对话即可获取专业维权指导：软裁员应对、赔偿计算、证据收集、仲裁流程。企业有法务，员工有 WorkPowers。
skills.why_zh: 给建议前先查判例的胜诉与败诉模式：你没满足的列进补证据清单，你踩了的先改。录音只认你自己在场的那种。
skills.why_en: Before advising, it checks the win and loss patterns in comparable rulings: what you have not satisfied becomes your evidence to-do list, and what you have tripped over gets corrected first. It only counts recordings of conversations you were part of.
skills.limit_zh: 只做上海——社平工资、三倍封顶、各区仲裁委电话、医疗期标准全是上海口径，外地得自己换数。数据标注 2025–2026，政策年度一换就要核。它站员工这边，不给公司合规建议。和在架 arb-skill 在「辞退后算钱」这段重叠，它更早一步，从软裁员开始。
skills.limit_en: Shanghai only — the average-wage base, the triple-wage cap, the district arbitration phone numbers and the medical-leave standards are all local, so elsewhere you substitute your own numbers. Data is marked 2025–2026 and needs rechecking each policy year. It argues for the employee and offers employers nothing. Its post-dismissal math overlaps with arb-skill on the shelf; this one starts earlier, at the quiet squeeze-out.
skills.title_en: It tells you to go badge in even after they killed your access, and to call the police if you are blocked

skills.name: gtd
skills.title_zh: 只说「不错」不说「你真棒」的 GTD 教练
skills.tagline_zh: 开场先静默体检收件箱条数、陈旧项和上次回顾距今几天，然后拿最难看的那个数字直接开口。
skills.tagline_en: Runs a silent health check on inbox count, stale items and days since your last review, then opens on the worst number instead of narrating the check.
skills.desc_en: A Reminders-native Getting Things Done (GTD) workflow powered by Claude Code. This project implements a streamlined GTD system using Apple Reminders with an intelligent AI skill to orchestrate workflo
skills.why_zh: 语气规矩写得很死：可以说「不错」「这周挺稳」，不许说「你完成得真棒」。
skills.why_en: The style rules are the product: do the organising, let the user decide, and brief warmth only — 'Nice.' or 'Solid week.', never 'Great job completing all those tasks!'
skills.limit_zh: 只接 macOS 的 Apple 提醒事项和日历；脚本路径写成 .claude/skills/gtd/... 的相对路径，不在仓库目录里跑会找不到；它只做整理，决定还是你在提醒事项里点。
skills.limit_en: macOS Apple Reminders and Calendar only. Script paths are relative to .claude/skills/gtd/..., so it breaks outside the repo directory. It organises; you still make every call in Reminders.
skills.title_en: The GTD coach allowed to say 'nice' but not 'great job'

skills.name: teach-me
skills.title_zh: 会打断你含糊用词的苏格拉底式陪练
skills.tagline_zh: 先把话题铺成一棵树，分清哪一层只是分支、哪一层才是研究者真在吵的分歧，然后一路反问你。
skills.tagline_en: Maps your topic into a tree, separates the branches researchers agree on from the tensions they actually publish against each other over, and questions you down the path.
skills.desc_en: A personal learning environment that helps you find your unknown unknowns by grilling you against the consensus research on a particular topic or question.
skills.why_zh: 分支和真分歧不是一回事：监督对自监督只是分支，数据越多是否伤泛化才是分歧。
skills.why_en: Its distinction is the whole skill: supervised vs self-supervised is a branch; whether more data helps or amplifies spurious correlations is a tension. And a word used inconsistently is reasoning in quicksand.
skills.limit_zh: 它不给答案，只逼你想，急着要结论时会很难受；会话日记落在 diary/ 下；配套的文献综述依赖 Semantic Scholar 和联网搜索，没网时它会把整棵树标成未验证。
skills.limit_en: It won't hand you answers, which is genuinely uncomfortable when you're in a hurry. Session diaries land in diary/. The companion literature-review skill needs Semantic Scholar and web access; without it the tree is flagged unverified.
skills.title_en: The tutor that interrupts you for using a word loosely

skills.name: suno-songwriting
skills.title_zh: 题材加曲风不算完整需求的 Suno 词作台
skills.tagline_zh: 先访谈到段落结构、BPM、调性和声线都问清，再给一份歌词和一段可直接粘贴的风格提示词。
skills.tagline_en: Interviews you until section plan, BPM, key, vocal identity and vocal style are all actually decided, then delivers lyrics plus a paste-ready Suno style prompt.
skills.desc_en: An Open Agent Skill for writing, revising, translating, and adapting lyrics with Suno-ready style prompts, structure tags, and vocal direction.
skills.why_zh: 硬停：需求薄的新歌第一轮绝不出成品，只回一份需求清单和追问。
skills.why_en: It hard-stops: for a new song from a thin brief, the first response is an intake snapshot and questions, never the finished four-section output. And it refuses to treat topic-plus-mood as enough.
skills.limit_zh: 只产歌词和风格提示词，不生成音频也不替你上传 Suno；流程很啰嗦，想随手要一首得明说要草稿；约 60 个参考文件里的声线库是描述性画像，不是特定歌手的授权音色。
skills.limit_en: Lyrics and prompts only — no audio, no uploading to Suno. The interview is long by design; ask for a sketch if you want speed. The ~60 reference files describe vocal characters, not licensed artist voices.
skills.title_en: A topic plus a genre is not a complete brief

skills.name: ontopo
skills.title_zh: 能按有没有防空空间筛餐厅的以色列订位助手
skills.tagline_zh: 一次跨多个日期、多家店查空位，看菜单和价位，最后给一条你自己去点确认的预订链接。
skills.tagline_en: Sweeps availability across several dates and venues in one shot, reads menus with price filters, and hands back a booking link you confirm yourself.
skills.desc_en: Search Israeli restaurants, check availability across date ranges, and get booking links. Agent Skills format for OpenClaw, Claude, Cursor.
skills.why_zh: 它有个 --safe-zone 开关：按店里有没有「מרחב מוגן」防空空间来筛餐厅。
skills.why_en: There's a --safe-zone flag that filters venues by whether they have a מרחב מוגן — a protected space. Nothing else on the shelf thinks about dinner that way.
skills.limit_zh: 只覆盖以色列 27 个城市里上了 Ontopo 的餐厅；走的是官网背后的非公开接口，随时可能失效或与真实房态不符；它不替你订位，只生成链接。
skills.limit_en: Only venues on Ontopo, across 27 Israeli cities. It rides the site's undocumented internal API, which can break or lag real availability. It never places the reservation — it gives you the link.
skills.title_en: The Israeli table-finder with a bomb-shelter filter

skills.name: apple-voice-memos
skills.title_zh: 不让整段逐字稿挤进主对话的语音备忘录读取器
skills.tagline_zh: 只读 iCloud 同步过的语音备忘录数据库，从 m4a 的 tsrp 原子里取出苹果本机生成的转写并整理成笔记。
skills.tagline_en: Queries the CloudRecordings database read-only, then pulls Apple's on-device transcript straight out of the m4a's tsrp atom and turns it into notes with actions and asides.
skills.desc_en: An agent skill to extract and process transcripts from Apple Voice Memos into useful summaries.
skills.why_zh: 转写故意交给子代理去取，就为了别让整段逐字稿占掉主对话的上下文。
skills.why_en: It spawns a sub-agent for the extraction on purpose — so a forty-minute transcript never lands in the main conversation.
skills.limit_zh: 只限开了 iCloud 同步的 macOS；转写是苹果在设备本机生成的，没有转写的录音它读不出来，也不会自己转写音频，只会明确告诉你 tsrp 原子找不到。
skills.limit_en: macOS with Voice Memos iCloud sync only. Transcripts are Apple's, generated on-device; recordings without one simply can't be read, and it will not transcribe audio itself.
skills.title_en: The voice-memo reader that keeps the transcript out of your context

skills.name: fashion
skills.title_zh: 站在试衣间里不许你说「再想想」的造型师
skills.tagline_zh: 记住你的身形、色系和整个衣柜，出门前给两三套完整搭配，缺什么直接附购买链接和该看的尺码。
skills.tagline_en: Learns your body, palette and entire wardrobe, then hands you two or three complete outfits — with a tested shop link and a size for whatever you're missing.
skills.desc_en: Personal AI stylist skill for Claude Code and Claude Cowork — wardrobe inventory, outfit recommendations, pre-purchase checks, in-store mode, and more.
skills.why_zh: 门店模式的硬规矩：别叫他回去想想，他站在试衣间里现在就要一个决定。
skills.why_en: In-store mode is blunt on purpose: give a verdict first, never suggest they sleep on it, and say when €89 of fabric isn't worth it.
skills.limit_zh: 购物链接只到 Zalando.de、Amazon.de 和 Vinted.de，德国以外基本用不上；导入订单、比价和上新提醒要 Chrome 桌面版；手机上装不了，只能靠它导一份文字摘要。
skills.limit_en: Shop links are Zalando.de / Amazon.de / Vinted.de — outside Germany they're near useless. Order import, price alerts and brand watching need desktop Chrome. No mobile; you get an exported text summary instead.
skills.title_en: The stylist who refuses to let you 'think about it' in the fitting room

skills.name: kaoyan-english-one-sentence-trainer
skills.title_zh: 仿真阅读跟真题重合 12 个词就作废的长难句训练
skills.tagline_zh: 仓库不带一句真题，句库全从你自己的 PDF 建；生成的仿真阅读要过一道校验——跟你的语料连续重合 12 个词就打回。
skills.tagline_en: The repo ships no exam text at all — the sentence bank is built from your own PDFs. Every mock passage it writes must clear one check: twelve consecutive words overlapping your corpus and it goes back.
skills.desc_en: 基于2001—2026年考研英语一真题资料研究的阅读与长难句训练 Codex Skill，仓库不含真题。
skills.why_zh: 「能追溯到本地资料的才算真题原句」这条把自己锁死了：模型不许补缺失年份，仿真稿也不许写回语料库。
skills.why_en: One rule locks the whole thing down: only sentences traceable to your local files count as real exam sentences. The model may not fill in missing years, and mock passages never get written back into the corpus.
skills.limit_zh: 你手上得先有 2001–2026 英语一真题的 PDF，仓库一句都不给。命令是 PowerShell 写法、走 Codex 自带的 Python，别的环境要自己改。首轮只给原句和出处，不译不拆，除非你说「不会，直接讲解」。
skills.limit_en: You need your own PDFs of the 2001–2026 papers; the repo hands you none. Commands are written for PowerShell and the bundled Codex Python, so other setups need rewriting. The first pass shows only the sentence and its source, with no translation and no parse, unless you say you would rather just see the explanation.
skills.title_en: Scraps a mock passage that shares twelve words with a real one

skills.name: siff26-ticket-planning
skills.title_zh: 算你够不够时间回家躺 45 分钟的上影节排片参谋
skills.tagline_zh: 抢票时只看开场时间，忘了片长、散场和跨影院堵车。它把 44 家影院两两之间的车程和地铁换乘先算好，再排买票顺序。
skills.tagline_en: In a ticket rush you look at start times and forget runtime, the walk out and cross-town traffic. This precomputes driving and metro times between all 44 festival cinemas, then orders your buying queue.
skills.desc_en: 2026年上海电影节行程规划Skill
skills.why_zh: 同影院连场它不当优点：会把散场缓冲、回家车程、提前到场一起算，够 45 分钟才让你回家躺。
skills.why_en: Two films at one cinema is not automatically good: it adds up the exit buffer, the trip home and early arrival, and only sends you home if 45 minutes survive.
skills.limit_zh: 它只服务第 28 届上海国际电影节，排片是内置的 2026 年数据，展映一结束这件东西就作废。驾车矩阵是 OSRM 自由流基线不是实时路况，早晚高峰要按它给的系数自己乘 2.0；地铁矩阵按站点邻接图估算，不含末班车。
skills.limit_en: It serves exactly one event, the 28th Shanghai International Film Festival, on a bundled 2026 schedule — once the festival ends this thing is dead weight. The driving matrix is an OSRM free-flow baseline, not live traffic, so rush hours need its own 2.0 multiplier applied by hand. The metro matrix is estimated from a station adjacency graph and ignores last trains.
skills.title_en: Works out whether you have time to go home and lie down

skills.name: car-repair
skills.title_zh: 结算单上要写一行「旧件归还」的汽修防坑参谋
skills.tagline_zh: 报价拆成配件费和工时费分开看，先问能不能修再谈总成更换，旧件必须带走。每条诊断都标自查、到店，还是立即停驶。
skills.tagline_en: Split the quote into parts and labour and read them separately, ask whether it can be repaired before you accept a whole-assembly swap, and take the removed parts home with you. Every diagnosis is tagged: check it yourself, get to a shop soon, or stop driving now.
skills.desc_en: 汽车维修与保养助手技能：故障诊断、保养规划、费用评估与维修防坑
skills.why_zh: 敲击金属声加机油灯直接判立即停驶，继续开会拉缸；反复打火每次别超 10 秒、间隔至少 30 秒。
skills.why_en: A metallic knock plus the oil light means stop driving immediately — keep going and you scuff the cylinder. And when it will not start: never crank longer than ten seconds, wait at least thirty between tries.
skills.limit_zh: 价格区间是中国大陆普通合资/国产车口径，豪华车上浮 50%–150%，而且没标采集日期，会过时。自查方法限于车主无工具能做的，需要举升机和诊断仪的它只让你去店里。不替代专业维修，高压电、气囊、刹车总泵一律劝你别碰。
skills.limit_en: Price bands are for ordinary joint-venture and domestic cars in mainland China, with luxury marques running 50–150% higher, and no capture date is given, so they will drift. Self-checks are limited to what an owner can do without tools; anything needing a lift or a scanner is sent straight to a shop. It is not a substitute for a mechanic and tells you to keep away from high-voltage packs, airbags and brake master cylinders.
skills.title_en: The repair-shop chaperone that makes you write "old parts returned" on the invoice

skills.name: barista
skills.title_zh: 不许说「有什么可以帮你」，先反问三轮的咖啡顾问
skills.tagline_zh: 说不清参数、只会说「太苦了」的人最需要有人替他缩小范围。它先追问器具、豆卡和水质，三轮之后才给一个动作。
skills.tagline_en: People who can only say "it tastes bitter" need someone to narrow the field for them. This asks about your gear, your bean label and your water for three rounds before naming one thing to change.
skills.desc_en: 咖啡师教练技能：覆盖意式萃取、多种冲煮、咖啡豆与感官品鉴，支持新手大白话+口诀，可联网检索名咖/博主萃取方案与变压曲线。
skills.why_zh: 点名的冠军配方和变压曲线必须联网核实，查不到就退成「通用参考」，不许拿一个具体压力数字充数。
skills.why_en: Named champion recipes and pressure profiles must be verified online; if they cannot be found it downgrades to a labelled generic baseline rather than inventing a pressure figure.
skills.limit_zh: 它不等你提问，第一句就是追问——想直接要答案的人装了会烦。名家配方和变压曲线要能联网才查得到，离线时只剩通用起步参数。附带的特调清单是小红书公开笔记的链接标注，正文自己写了 token 有时效、链接会过期。它也不碰咖啡机维修、开店经营和速溶。
skills.limit_en: It does not wait for your question — the first line is a probe, which will annoy anyone who just wants an answer. Named recipes and pressure curves need web access; offline you get generic starting parameters. The bundled craft-drink list is link annotation of public Xiaohongshu notes, and the file notes those tokens expire. Machine repair, cafe operations and instant coffee are out of scope.
skills.title_en: Never opens with "how can I help" — it interrogates you first

skills.name: annual-diary-insight
skills.title_zh: 只认「哪天之后你回不去了」的年度日记复盘
skills.tagline_zh: 年度洞察要精读全年日记后人写；大事记只问一句「哪天之后你回不去了」，一年五到八条，还专收「未遂里程碑」。
skills.tagline_en: The yearly piece has to be written by hand after reading every entry. The milestone list asks one question — which day did you stop being able to go back — five to eight a year, including the ones that almost happened.
skills.desc_en: annual-diary-insight 是一个把多年日记变成「年度洞察」与「全景看板」的 skill。功能 A：逐篇精读当年日记，人写十段式深度复盘（数字快照、主题、身份、金句、给明年），不靠统计填模板。功能 B：读取各年洞察，自动生成单页离线 HTML 看板，含主题、情绪、节律、里程碑时间线等七模块。纯 Python 标准库、无外部依赖、图表库内联，换库只需填一份 vault-profile
skills.why_zh: 它故意不给「自动生成正文」的脚本：统计只说明反复提到什么，跳过精读的必然是换年份也成立的废话。
skills.why_en: It deliberately ships no script that writes the yearly piece for you: word frequencies only show what you kept mentioning, and skipping the close read produces prose that would be true of any year.
skills.limit_zh: 得先有几年成体量的日记，没日记它无事可做。看板的时间线直接读洞察里人工标的条目，洞察没写就是空的，顺序只能先 A 再 B。单页 HTML 有 1.1 MB，正文说这是把 ECharts 内联进去换离线可用的刻意取舍。
skills.limit_en: You need several years of substantial diary entries; without them there is nothing to run. The dashboard timeline reads the milestones you marked by hand in the yearly pieces, so it stays empty until those exist, and the order is fixed. The single-page HTML weighs 1.1 MB because ECharts is inlined to keep it usable offline — a trade the file states outright.
skills.title_en: Only counts the day after which you could not go back

skills.name: ingredient-decision
skills.title_zh: 防晒里阿伏苯宗配错就悄悄归零的成分表判官
skills.tagline_zh: 成分表不是清单的加和，是化学系统。超过一个活性物就必须过一遍六类配伍：刺激叠加、互相失活、光敏、致敏、促渗、协同。
skills.tagline_en: An ingredient list is a chemical system, not a sum of items. Any formula with more than one active must be run through six interaction mechanisms: irritation stacking, mutual deactivation, photosensitivity, preservative sensitisation, penetration amplification, and genuine synergy.
skills.desc_en: 化妆品/护肤品配方成分分析能力包（WorkBuddy Skill）：单成分风险评估 + 组合配伍分析 + 配方整体评价，基于《化妆品安全技术规范》/IECIC/SCCS/CIR 等权威来源。
skills.why_zh: 先分清淋洗类还是驻留类，否则 MIT 驻留禁用、水杨酸限值差异这类法规比对根本不会触发。
skills.why_en: It settles rinse-off versus leave-on first, because otherwise the regulatory checks that matter — MIT banned in leave-on products, different salicylic acid caps — never fire at all.
skills.limit_zh: 中国大陆法规口径（《化妆品安全技术规范》/IECIC），欧美产品限值要另判。只看成分表不看浓度——绝大多数配方不公布浓度，它只能按排位推。判定档位只有安全/注意/谨慎三档，不给绝对结论，也不看皮肤病。库外成分要联网检索。
skills.limit_en: Built on mainland China regulation (Safety and Technical Standards for Cosmetics, IECIC); EU and US limits need separate judgement. It reads the list, not the concentrations — almost no brand publishes those, so it can only infer from ordering. Verdicts come in three bands only, never absolutes, and it will not read a skin condition. Ingredients outside its bundled library need a web lookup.
skills.title_en: The ingredient-list judge that catches sunscreen quietly dropping to zero

skills.name: win-disk-cleaner
skills.title_zh: 写明 WinSxS 只准 DISM 清的清理单
skills.tagline_zh: 按你是不是开发者、要不要保留休眠定制一份 PowerShell 脚本，先跑 DryRun，再逐项列出能腾出多少空间。
skills.tagline_en: Generates a PowerShell script tailored to whether you develop, whether you need hibernate, and which Chinese apps you run — with a dry-run mode and per-module skip flags.
skills.desc_en: Free Windows C: drive cleanup skill for AI agents (Claude Code). Replaces paid system optimizer software.
skills.why_zh: 一张「能不能删」对照表：WinSxS 只准 DISM 清理，永远不要手动删。
skills.why_en: Its safe-to-remove table is the product: hiberfil.sys yes if you don't hibernate, Windows.old yes after the new OS proves out, WinSxS DISM-only and never manually.
skills.limit_zh: 只管 Windows，macOS 和 Linux 用不上；脚本要管理员权限，关休眠、删还原点、清 WinSxS 都不可逆；中文系统必须存成带 BOM 的 UTF-8，否则脚本乱码。
skills.limit_en: Windows only. Needs admin, and hibernation, restore points and WinSxS cleanup are irreversible. On Chinese Windows the script must be saved as UTF-8 with BOM or it mangles.
skills.title_en: The C: drive cleanup that says WinSxS is DISM-only, never by hand

skills.name: smart-file-organizer
skills.title_zh: 默认绕开所有源码文件的下载目录整理器
skills.tagline_zh: 读文件内容再重命名，乱码文件名逐个试编码救回来，全程留一张可以回滚的新旧对照表。
skills.tagline_en: Reads what's actually inside a file before renaming it, recovers mojibake names by trying EUC-KR / CP949 / Shift_JIS / GB2312 against the raw bytes, and keeps a rollback map the whole way.
skills.desc_en: File/Folder Organizer Skill. Easily Sort and Rename based on Entire Contents!
skills.why_zh: 它默认不动代码：改名会毁掉 import 路径、include 指令和构建系统。
skills.why_en: It skips code by default, and says why: renaming breaks import paths, include directives and build systems. Datasets get flagged and asked about, not silently churned.
skills.limit_zh: 超过 50 个文件会拆批交给子代理，并要求子代理免确认执行，第一次务必先在副本上跑；数据集目录靠「同后缀 100+ 个文件」这类启发式识别，识别到会先问你。
skills.limit_en: Past 50 files it splits into sub-agent batches and asks them to run auto-approved — do your first run on a copy. Dataset detection is heuristic (100+ files sharing an extension, sequential names) and prompts you per directory.
skills.title_en: The file organiser that walks around your source code

skills.name: astrology
skills.title_zh: 拒绝凭记忆报出一个行星位置的占星师
skills.tagline_zh: 本地星历引擎实算西洋、印度和八字三套盘，再按古典规则解读，三套系统说法一致的地方才当结论。
skills.tagline_en: Casts real charts — Western tropical, Vedic sidereal, Chinese BaZi — from a local ephemeris, then reads them against classical rulesets and treats agreement across traditions as its strongest signal.
skills.desc_en: Astrology MCP server & Agent Skill — birth charts, transits, synastry across Western, Vedic/Jyotish & Chinese BaZi. Deterministic zero-dependency Python engine. 18 MCP tools, 31 REST endpoints, ChatGP
skills.why_zh: 它给自己定的唯一底线：引擎算天空，你只负责读，绝不发明一个行星位置。
skills.why_en: One rule separates it from every hallucinating chatbot: the engine computes the sky, you only read it. Gambling questions are refused outright.
skills.limit_zh: 解读框架是占星传统，不是科学；明确拒绝彩票和赌球预测，健康只谈体质倾向并让你去看医生；要跑本地 Python 引擎，想要角秒精度和 Placidus 宫位得另装 pyswisseph。
skills.limit_en: The interpretation is tradition, not science. Health goes to body-tendency talk and a referral to a real doctor; no medication or treatment advice. Needs local Python; arcsecond precision requires installing pyswisseph.
skills.title_en: The astrologer that will not invent a planetary position

skills.name: nvc-communication
skills.title_zh: 不许你说「当我看到…我感到…」的非暴力沟通教练
skills.tagline_zh: 想提意见又怕撕破脸时用。它把四要素留在心里当脚手架，只交给你一句能直接发出去的自然中文，拆解放后面、可选。
skills.tagline_en: For when you want to raise something without blowing up the relationship. The four components stay in its head as scaffolding; what comes back is one natural sentence you can actually send, with the breakdown optional and last.
skills.desc_en: 非暴力沟通(NVC) Claude Code skill：把指责性语言拆成 观察+感受+需要+请求，帮你在冲突/情绪场景把话说对。
skills.why_zh: 「请求还是命令」的判据不在措辞，在被拒之后你会不会施压——这条比四要素本身更难做到。
skills.why_en: Whether something is a request or a demand is not settled by wording but by what you do when the answer is no — a rule harder to follow than the four components themselves.
skills.limit_zh: 它只给措辞，不替你判断该不该跟对方翻脸——正文明写事务性邮件只借「观察不评论」和「具体正向的请求」两条，不谈感受；不确定时它会先问你「更想被理解，还是更想把事推进」。
skills.limit_en: It gives you wording, not a verdict on whether to confront someone. For transactional email it borrows only two principles, observation without evaluation and a concrete positive request, and skips feelings entirely. Everything traces to one Rosenberg book, and when the situation is unclear it asks whether you want to be understood or want the thing to move.
skills.title_en: Bans the "when I see… I feel…" template from an NVC coach

skills.name: chenshi-nutrition
skills.title_zh: 可能先叫你别减、把代谢修回来的运动营养师
skills.tagline_zh: 每周只减自身体重的百分之一到二，掉太快的都算脱水和掉肌肉。它先看你的瘦素、皮质醇和睡眠，再决定这轮要不要开赤字。
skills.tagline_en: One to two percent of bodyweight a week, and anything faster counts as water and muscle rather than fat. It looks at leptin, cortisol and your sleep before deciding whether this round gets a deficit at all.
skills.desc_en: 🥗 陈石（Mars）运动营养师 Claude Code Skill — 营养矩阵40课体系、瘦素/皮质醇/胰岛素抵抗深度解析、麦克唐拉德增肌模型、可执行行动协议
skills.why_zh: 「暴食往往是之前过度限制的必然反弹」这句掀翻了意志力话术，配套动作是先修好你和食物的关系。
skills.why_en: One line does the work: binge eating is usually the inevitable rebound from having restricted too hard. What follows is repairing your relationship with food, not more willpower.
skills.limit_zh: 它是粉丝自制的非官方项目，正文写明「不代表其本人立场」。给的是运动营养教育和生活方式指导，不做诊断也不开处方；涉及进食障碍、严重代谢紊乱或临床抑郁时会让你去找医生或注册营养师。褪黑素这类补剂它不推荐常规使用。 上游 SKILL.md 的 name 带空格和括号，装上后可能不被识别，改成 chenshi-nutrition 更稳。
skills.limit_en: This is an unofficial fan-made distillation and says so, and does not represent the nutritionist's own positions. What it offers is sports-nutrition education and lifestyle guidance, not diagnosis or prescription, and it routes eating disorders, serious metabolic disruption and clinical depression to a doctor or registered dietitian. It also declines to recommend melatonin as a routine supplement. Upstream's name field has spaces and parentheses, so the loader may not pick it up — rename it to chenshi-nutrition.
skills.title_en: May tell you to stop cutting and repair your metabolism first

skills.name: mindmirror
skills.title_zh: 把「我朋友想不开」直接当本人求助的心理陪伴
skills.tagline_zh: 华人爱用「我帮朋友问」做面子保护式求助——第三人称一旦带危机信号，它不再要求「让本人来」，直接按本人处理。
skills.tagline_en: People often borrow a friend's name to ask for help without losing face. So the moment a third-person account carries a crisis signal, this one stops asking to speak to the person and answers as if it is them.
skills.desc_en: 把 Claude 调成「有人味的心理陪伴者」的 Claude Code Skill · Common Factors + 危机协议 + PHQ-9/GAD-7/PSS-10 + Stanley & Brown 安全计划
skills.why_zh: 反越狱清单里唯一一条例外给了「第三人称+危机信号」——它知道防越狱和防漏救人会打架，选了后者。
skills.why_en: Its long jailbreak list has exactly one carve-out — third person plus crisis signal — because refusing a proxy request and missing a real one are the same mistake.
skills.limit_zh: 热线只有中国大陆的 12356/120/110，未成年人给 12355，别处得自己换。许可证 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0，明写禁止商业用途与临床诊断。正文承认跨会话检测「在当前 AI 无跨会话记忆的情况下不可执行」，已改成同一会话内计数。
skills.limit_en: The hotlines are mainland China only (12356, 120, 110, plus 12355 for minors), so you supply local numbers elsewhere. Licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0: no commercial use, no clinical diagnosis. The file also admits cross-session detection "cannot be executed" without cross-session memory and falls back to counting inside one session.
skills.title_en: Treats "asking for a friend" as the friend asking

skills.name: balcony-farmer
skills.title_zh: 把「采收前 7 天停药」写成硬规则的阳台种菜参谋
skills.tagline_zh: 叶子黄了、有虫了，网上第一条永远是「喷点药」。它按物理→生物→天然药剂排序，化学农药排最后，还点名国家禁用的那几种。
skills.tagline_en: A yellow leaf or a bug, and the first answer online is always "spray something". This works in order — physical, then biological, then natural agents — with chemical pesticides last, and it names the banned ones.
skills.desc_en: 阳台农夫 - 城市家庭种植智能顾问 | Balcony Farmer - Smart Urban Gardening Advisor | TRAE SOLO Skill
skills.why_zh: 它管的是你要吃的菜：一旦动到化学农药，就必须写出采收前 7–14 天的停药期，养花指南里没人写这条。
skills.why_en: This is food you will eat: the moment a chemical pesticide enters the plan it must state the 7-to-14-day pre-harvest withdrawal period, which ornamental plant guides never do.
skills.limit_zh: 它只覆盖阳台、窗台和室内，明写不管农田与大规模农业，爬藤的南瓜西瓜也不推荐给小阳台。识别植物靠你用文字描述叶形花色，它不看图，认不出来就让你去用形色或花伴侣拍照。严重病害不给治疗建议，直接让你找专业园艺师。
skills.limit_en: Scope is balcony, windowsill and indoors only; it says outright that farmland and large-scale agriculture are out, and it will not recommend sprawling vines like pumpkin or watermelon for a small balcony. Plant identification runs on your written description of leaf shape and flower colour — it does not look at photos, and sends you to a phone identifier app instead. For serious disease it refuses to prescribe and tells you to find a horticulturist.
skills.title_en: Treats "stop spraying 7 days before harvest" as a hard rule

skills.name: nocebo-parenting
